item.title: Banana warehouse gutted in major fire in Balasore
item.description: A banana warehouse was gutted in a major fire that broke out at Phandi Chhak near Sahadev Khunta police station in Odisha’s Balasore late Tuesday night. Goods worth several lakhs of rupees were destroyed in the incident. The cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained. item.title: Bhubaneswar supermarket fire doused after 21-hour operation; building lacked NOC
item.description: A massive fire that broke out at a supermarket in the Lingipur area of Bhubaneswar was brought under control after nearly 21 hours of continuous firefighting, officials said on Wednesday. Deputy Fire Officer Narayan Das confirmed that the blaze was doused at around 4 pm, although smoke continued to emanate from parts of the building. item.title: Is Odisha’s record Rs 4 crore seizure the start of a bigger anti-graft storm?
item.description: Odisha Vigilance on Wednesday recorded the highest-ever cash seizure in its history, recovering more than Rs 4 crore from the Bhubaneswar flat of Debabrata Mohanty, Deputy Director of Mines, Cuttack Circle. The massive recovery followed a trap operation in which Mohanty was allegedly caught accepting a Rs 30,000 bribe from a licensed coal vendor. item.description: Railway authorities seized foreign currency notes along with Rs 2.69 lakh in Indian cash from Dunguripali Railway Station in Odisha’s Sonepur district after a youth fled the spot, officials said on Wednesday. item.title: Class 7 student dies after 48-day battle with burn injuries; family protests in Rayagada
item.description: Tension gripped Rayagada district after a Class VII student, who had sustained severe burn injuries in a fire incident at his school, died on Tuesday following a 48-day battle for life. The deceased has been identified as Biren Takri, a student of Paikadakuluguda Upgraded High School. item.title: India abstains on UNGA draft seeking immediate Russia-Ukraine ceasefire
item.description: India on Tuesday abstained from voting on a United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) draft resolution seeking an immediate, complete, and unconditional ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. The resolution, titled ‘Support for Lasting Peace in Ukraine’, was adopted on the fourth anniversary of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.
